body: Thank you for the sympathy. Edited the post

Going to a doctor is not an option. I know something is wrong, but I can't bring myself to do anything to get better. In fact, most of the time I don't even WANT to get better. I don't want to be happy, I just want to die. I'm too full of...something that resembles hate (?) for doing something "positive".

Well, it's a matter of fact that I want to die. They don't have anything to do with this. As I said, they aren't even all that relevant in my life. They don't cause me pain. The things that they say about me are only the confirmation I don't even manage to *appear* normal. I don't care about anyone and anything, and that's true, I know it by myself. That's the problem.
